profile.summary: Bay Alarm is a security company that provides burglar alarms, fire alarms, video security, access control, and 24/7 monitoring for businesses and homes. It also offers on-site security agents. The company was founded in Oakland in 1946 and serves customers in California, Arizona, and Washington.
